tasks.description: Expose the accepted private profile settings read and reminder-hour update on the normal owner HTTP routes.
constraints: Scope the accepted SQL to owner GET /me and POST /commands profile.update only. Return valid Git diff in JSON with exact source context. Controller applies and checks. No live, iOS, StoreKit, scheduler, notification claims, entitlement/schema changes, or unrelated handlers.

GET /me uses existing active permanent owner resolution, no other owner injection, reads canonical read_owner_profile_settings via service client and returns {profile:{preferred_locale,reminder_hour_local}}. Preserve strict response validation, private/no-store, 401/403 for unauthenticated/guest and retryable 503 for impossible result/unavailable adapter. Reject unexpected queries. Follow existing path prefix normalization.

profile.update uses existing command envelope. Require plant_id null or absent, bound operation UUID consistent with headers and p_owner_id from Auth, payload_json only reminder_hour_local integer 0..23. Use accepted execute_profile_reminder_hour_update. Return canonical {profile:{preferred_locale,reminder_hour_local},watermark}, exact receipt replay; map malformed input to 400, mismatch to 409, forbidden owner to 403, unexpected RPC failure or response to retryable 503. No storage or side effects beyond accepted RPC.

Exercise normal route dispatch in focused Deno fixtures using established mock fetch/client, verifying owner binding, closed envelopes, endpoint privacy, default/current reads, 0/23, stale retry, canonical response failure. Keep existing care and unrelated routes behaving as before. T083/T084 and scheduling remain open.

acceptance_criteria.description: Production Deno typing and scoped diff pass.
Normal routed owner reads/writes, private responses and invalid input regression pass on fixtures.
